```
|             |             |             |             |
+-------------+-------------+-------------+-------------+
|             |                           | Rahu        |
|             |                           | Venus       |

| Ketu        |                           | Sun         |
|             |                           | Moon        |

|             | Mars        | Mercury     |             |
|             |             | Jupiter     |             |
|             |             | Saturn      |             |
+-------------+-------------+-------------+-------------+
```

No lagna marker is printed on this chart, so house numbers are **not** assigned. Signs follow the fixed South Indian cell positions.

| Sign | Planets |
|---|---|
| Cancer | Rahu, Venus |
| Leo | Sun, Moon |
| Libra | Mercury, Jupiter, Saturn |
| Scorpio | Mars |
| Capricorn | Ketu |
